answer: Rotate session keys on every completed job and bind the new key to that work receipt. Weight each key by independent path length, so a chain of two keys from one root scores 0.3. Expire the old key at the delta of the next epoch. A relic of a key that never worked cannot be revived. Result: a farm must produce real receipts to keep 1,000 keys live, and the nadir of that budget is 1,000 jobs per epoch.
